contract_general_p1: • All software, systems, and artificial intelligence operating the platform are the exclusive property of Silacod.
contract_general_p2: • By using the platform, you agree to digitally sign contracts and receipts via the integrated DamaneSign service, and these signatures are legally binding.
contract_general_p3: • All commercial disputes are governed by Moroccan law, and exclusive jurisdiction is granted to the courts of the city of Casablanca.
contract_vendor_p1: • The wholesaler guarantees that all presented products are authentic and conform to the photos and descriptions provided.
contract_vendor_p2: • Stock status must be updated periodically; the platform is not responsible for orders placed on unavailable products.
contract_vendor_p3: • The merchant acknowledges full legal responsibility for product quality and hidden defects in accordance with Moroccan law.
contract_vendor_p4: • Merchant funds are collected after confirmation of product receipt by the final customer and expiration of the legal return period.
contract_influencer_p1: • The influencer agrees to promote products in a professional manner and not make false promises to consumers.
contract_influencer_p2: • All marketing content (images/videos) provided by the platform is protected intellectual property, and use is allowed only within the scope of Silacod campaigns.
contract_influencer_p3: • Claimed products do not appear in the influencer's account until after review and acceptance by the platform's technical support team.
contract_influencer_p4: • Commissions are calculated based on actual, paid sales and are disbursed according to the schedule specified in the dashboard.
contract_seller_p1: • The "Seller" acknowledges that their role is limited solely to marketing and selling products available in the platform's/suppliers' warehouses, and they have no right to add external products.
contract_seller_p2: • All submitted orders are audited by the platform administration before being sent to the shipping company.
contract_seller_p3: • The seller agrees to protect final customer data (Leads) privacy and not use it outside the scope of finalizing sales transactions via the platform, in compliance with CNDP laws.
contract_seller_p4: • Any attempt to manipulate the system or bypass commissions will result in immediate account suspension.
